core_concept: Using browser developer tools, specifically the inspector, allows front-end developers to examine and modify the HTML and CSS of a web page in real-time. The inspector enables pinpointing specific elements by right-clicking and selecting 'Inspect' or 'Inspect Element'. This functionality is crucial for debugging, understanding styling, and testing changes without modifying the original code.
technical_breakdown: The browser's developer tools provide a visual representation of the web page's structure.
The inspector allows you to select individual HTML elements for detailed examination.
You can modify CSS properties directly within the inspector to observe the immediate effects on the page.
Right-clicking on an element and selecting 'Inspect' is the primary method to activate the inspector.
